description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutablePropertyFilter' that implements 'PropertySearchFilter'. It provides factory methods to create instances with specific filters, and methods to access its properties, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutablePropertyFilter
classes.description: An immutable class that encapsulates property search filtering criteria, including type, property path, and matching values.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of ImmutablePropertyFilter with specified parameters, either with a collection of values or singular/multiple JsonValues.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the filter.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer representing the property path.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable collection of JsonValue objects representing filter values.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare filters based on type, property path, and values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode based on type, property path, and values.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the filter, detailing type, property path, and values.
